        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        String s = br.readLine();
        int[] freq = new int[3];
        List<Integer>[] pos = new ArrayList[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) pos[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] count = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == 'V') {
                freq[0]++;
                pos[0].add(i + 1);
            } else if (c == 'K') {
                freq[1]++;
                pos[1].add(i + 1);
            } else {
                freq[2]++;
                pos[2].add(i + 1);
            }
        }
        int[][][][] dp = new int[freq[0]+1][freq[1]+1][freq[2]+1][3];
        for (int[][][] x : dp) for (int[][] y : x) for (int[] z : y) Arrays.fill(z, -1);
        pw.println(dfs(0,0,0,2,freq,pos,dp));
        pw.close();
    }

    static int dfs(int vCount, int kCount, int sCount, int last, int[] freq, List<Integer>[] pos, int[][][][] dp) {
        if (vCount == freq[0] && kCount == freq[1] && sCount == freq[2]) return 0;
        if (dp[vCount][kCount][sCount][last] != -1) return dp[vCount][kCount][sCount][last];
        int res = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (vCount < freq[0]) {
            int p = pos[0].get(vCount);
            int move = Math.max(p - 1 - vCount, 0) + Math.max(p - 1 - kCount, 0) + Math.max(p - 1 - sCount, 0);
            res = Math.min(res, dfs(vCount + 1, kCount, sCount, 0, freq, pos, dp) + move);
        }
        if (kCount < freq[1] && last != 0) {
            int p = pos[1].get(kCount);
            int move = Math.max(p - 1 - vCount, 0) + Math.max(p - 1 - kCount, 0) + Math.max(p - 1 - sCount, 0);
            res = Math.min(res, dfs(vCount, kCount + 1, sCount, 1, freq, pos, dp) + move);
        }
        if (sCount < freq[2]) {
            int p = pos[2].get(sCount);
            int move = Math.max(p - 1 - vCount, 0) + Math.max(p - 1 - kCount, 0) + Math.max(p - 1 - sCount, 0);
            res = Math.min(res, dfs(vCount, kCount, sCount + 1, 2, freq, pos, dp) + move);
        }
        return dp[vCount][kCount][sCount][last] = res;
    }
}
